data_objects.name: category_measurement_series
data_objects.meaning: An ordered multivariate series of numeric measurements for medium-industrial, large-industrial, agricultural, residential, and full or overall categories.
data_objects.notes: The category expansions are inferred from abbreviated column labels; the measured phenomenon and observation cadence are not supplied.

variables.name: Unnamed: 0
variables.meaning: Sequential exported row index that preserves series order.

variables.name: MedInd
variables.meaning: Measurement for the category abbreviated MedInd, plausibly medium industry.

variables.name: LarInd
variables.meaning: Measurement for the category abbreviated LarInd, plausibly large industry.

variables.name: Full
variables.meaning: Full or overall measurement associated with the category-specific series.

structure.description: Each row is one position in an ordered sequence; Unnamed: 0 is a nonrepeating sequential index and candidate row key.
The category columns are aligned measurements at the same sequence position, with Full representing an overall series whose exact aggregation rule is not declared.

uncertainties: The measured phenomenon, physical unit, time origin, and sampling cadence are absent from the CSV.
MedInd and LarInd label expansions and the exact relationship between Full and the category series remain inferred rather than documented.
annotation_notes: Only the declared neutral train.csv informed this task-independent description.
